entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I think that's understandable. I'm sure you identified with the loss.
entries.speaker: Father McCue

entries.text: I considered that, um-- but then I saw something last night, which I-- which I can't explain. I saw a man in dark clothes, but he had four faces. They weren't human.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Is this what you saw? It's a seraphim. An angel... With four faces. Those of a man, a lion, an eagle and a bull. In the story, the angel descends from heaven... And fathers four children with a mortal woman. Their offspring are the nephilim-- the fallen ones. They have the souls of angels, but they weren't meant to be. They're deformed, tormented. So the lord sends the seraphim to earth... To bring back the souls of the nephilim... To keep the devil from claiming them as his own.
entries.speaker: Father McCue

entries.text: How did he bring back their souls?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: They were smote with the brightness of his countenance. To look upon the seraphim in all his glory... Is to give up one's soul to heaven.
entries.speaker: Father McCue

entries.text: You think that's what I saw?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No. I think what you saw is a figment of your imagination. A half-remembered story from your childhood that surfaced because of this case.
entries.speaker: Father McCue

entries.text: But I saw it, Father.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Dana, the nephilim is a story. The text in which it appears isn't even recognized by the church.
entries.speaker: Father McCue

entries.text: Father, do you believe that god has his reasons?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yes, I'm certain of it. It's how he rewards our faith.
entries.speaker: Father McCue

entries.text: Agent Scully? I can't believe I found you.
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: What is it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Agent Mulder's been trying to reach you. He's been down at the station house.
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: Trying to reach me for what?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The fourth girl. She's at Father Gregory's church. Come on. I'll drive you.
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: There's no one here.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: They must be on their way. You don't see her in there? She's here. I know it.
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: [ thump ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Agent Scully? Did you find her? Agent Scully!
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: My name is Dana. I'm going to get you out of there, okay? I'm not gonna hurt you. I'm gonna take you someplace safe.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Where are you going? Where are you taking her?
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: Everything's going to be fine.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Bring her here! Bring me the girl!
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: It's okay, it's all right. Stay here. It's okay. Stay here. Just stay here. It's gonna be okay.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Bring her out to me.
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: Mommy, let me go. Mommy, please let me go.
entries.speaker: Emily

entries.text: Emily.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Agent Scully, get her out of there!
entries.speaker: Starkey

entries.text: Mommy, please.
entries.speaker: Emily

entries.text: Emily! Emily! Oh, god. Ohh.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You believed you were releasing her soul to heaven.
entries.speaker: Priest

entries.text: I felt sure of it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: But you still can't reconcile this belief with the physical fact of her death?
entries.speaker: Priest

entries.text: No. I thought I could, Father, but I can't.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Do you believe there is a life after this one?
entries.speaker: Priest

entries.text: Yes.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Are you sure? Has it occurred to you that maybe this, too, is part of what you were meant to understand?
entries.speaker: Priest

entries.text: You mean accepting my loss?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Can you accept it?
entries.speaker: Priest

entries.text: Maybe that's what faith is.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
